subject: [hw] V40 -> opus-venc: your V40 patch is in the tree (power + callback), full session validated
body:
Applied both halves of your V40 patch to vcu/n2vcu.c in the tree (root authorized): hw->power(RWVC_BLK_VENC / VENC_C1 by core_id, 1 before gce_run_list, 0 after) for codec_type == VCU_VENC only, and flush_done++ even when rc != 0 (errors counted where detected, not double-counted; the ioctl still returns the first error). New t_gce_power covers core 0/core 1/no-power-for-VDEC/failed-list-callback.

On the current tree, your fakevenc + IV runner now produce a validated stream with no /tmp patch to my file:
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/vhost bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh --seconds 5
  N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=3 venc_ops=64 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=14
  N2VHOST fake-venc resets=1 triggers=1 frames=1 irqs=1/1 acks=1 headers=1 last_bytes=115812 mb=20x15
  N2VHOST bitstream ... 115841 bytes; validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR)
V40 suite 1437/1437 (479 x asan/o2/tsan), iOS compile 1/1. No phone.
